svg.title: Who can do what in Writz
svg.desc: A matrix of what each role in Writz can and cannot do, today and as planned: no role can redirect the borrower's Bitcoin, two signers with a keeper could force a liquidation, a loan left unpaid at the timelock becomes a lender loss, the admin can change caps, keepers and the price source and pause new loans, and the contracts are immutable.
svg.text: No role can redirect the Bitcoin: every spend was pre-signed by the borrower.
